name: Kyouhaku
source:
You play Sakagami Yuya, who is a student at the school. One day, you get a lecture from your home room teacher about the poor grades. On the way home from school. you ask your friend Tagawa Shinta to play out of doors, but Tagawa invites you to come to his place. He says that there is a window in the house where he could see a house few blocks away, a married woman (Yamane Yuriko) was masturbating during the day..... You and him videotapes her, and go to the woman's place with it.......

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE023124.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
你扮演坂上裕也，她是学校的学生。有一天，你的班主任对你进行了一场关于你成绩不佳的训诫。放学回家的路上。你邀请你的朋友田川新太到户外玩耍，但田川邀请你去他的地方。他说房子里有一扇窗户，他可以看到几个街区外的房子，一个已婚妇女（山根百合子饰）正在白天自慰……你和他给她录像，然后带着它去那个女人的地方……
